description: Shared + API: live/consistent order tracking status (shared reconcileTracking used by GET /orders/:id and GET /orders/:id/tracking, mock shipping timeline driven by the order status, syncTracking that dedupes events / updates shipment.status / walks legal transitions), richer customer order detail payload (address, item returnability + variant attributes, return requests, reconciled tracking), standard return/cancel reason catalogue, customer return-photo upload endpoint, and server-side return validation (photos required for defect reasons, own-storage image URLs only, items/qty belong to the order). No Prisma schema change. Must land before FEAT-002 (the web page consumes this payload).
steps: 1. packages/shared/src/order-tracking.ts (new) + export from packages/shared/src/index.ts. Contents: ORDER_PROGRESS_STEPS: readonly OrderStatus[] = ['pending','confirmed','packed','shipped','out_for_delivery','delivered']; ORDER_STATUS_LABELS: Record<OrderStatus,string> = {pending:'Order placed', confirmed:'Confirmed', packed:'Packed', shipped:'Shipped', out_for_delivery:'Out for delivery', delivered:'Delivered', cancelled:'Cancelled', returned:'Returned'}; extra tracking labels {created:'Shipment created', picked_up:'Picked up', in_transit:'In transit', rto:'Returned to seller', refunded:'Refunded'}; normalizeStatus(s) = lowercase, trim, [\s-]+ -> '_'; statusLabel(s): known label else humanize ('some_status' -> 'Some status', '' -> 'Unknown'); TRACKING_PROGRESS_MAP {created:'packed', packed:'packed', picked_up:'shipped', in_transit:'shipped', shipped:'shipped', out_for_delivery:'out_for_delivery', delivered:'delivered'}; progressRank(s) = index in ORDER_PROGRESS_STEPS of the order status or mapped tracking status, -1 otherwise; isTerminalOrderStatus(s) = cancelled|returned; furthestStatus(orderStatus, trackingStatuses[]) -> terminal order status always wins, else ORDER_PROGRESS_STEPS[max rank of order + mapped tracking statuses].

2. In the same file: reconcileTracking(input) with types DateLike = Date|string|null|undefined; ReconcileInput {order:{status:OrderStatus; createdAt?:DateLike; updatedAt?:DateLike}; shipments: {id; awb?; courier?; status:string; trackingUrl?; estimatedDelivery?:DateLike; createdAt?:DateLike; events?: {status; description?; location?; occurredAt:DateLike}[]}[]}; TimelineEvent {status; label; description; location:string|null; occurredAt:string|null (ISO); derived:boolean}; ReconciledShipment {id; awb; courier; trackingUrl; estimatedDelivery:string|null; providerStatus:string; status:string; statusLabel:string; events:TimelineEvent[]}; ReconciledTracking {orderStatus; latestStatus; latestLabel; shipments: ReconciledShipment[]}. Rules per shipment: (a) collapse duplicate events with same normalized status + same occurredAt (old syncs duplicated them); (b) real events sorted NEWEST FIRST by occurredAt (missing/invalid dates last), label = statusLabel(status), description falls back to label; (c) eventMaxRank = max progressRank over events and shipment.status; derivationRank = progressRank(order.status), or rank('delivered') when order is 'returned', or -1 when 'cancelled'; for each step in ['packed','shipped','out_for_delivery','delivered'] with eventMaxRank < rank(step) <= derivationRank add a derived TimelineEvent {status:step, label, description:'Updated from your order status', location:null, derived:true, occurredAt: step==='packed' ? iso(shipment.createdAt) : (step===order.status && updatedAt >= newest real event time ? iso(order.updatedAt) : null)} - derived events go on TOP (rank desc) since they are further than every real event; (d) shipment.status = furthestStatus(order.status, [shipment.status, ...event statuses]); providerStatus keeps the raw DB value. latestStatus = furthestStatus(order.status, all shipments' raw statuses + event statuses); latestLabel = statusLabel(latestStatus). Never throws on missing dates (API specs pass orders without createdAt).

3. packages/shared/src/returns.ts (new) + export from index.ts: RETURN_REASON_CODES = ['damaged','defective','wrong_item','missing_item','expired','quality','size_fit','not_needed','other'] as const; RETURN_REASONS (code,label,photoRequired,allowReplace,commentRequired): damaged 'Damaged / broken product' photo+replace; defective 'Defective / not working' photo+replace; wrong_item 'Wrong item received' photo+replace; missing_item 'Item missing / incomplete' photo+replace; expired 'Expired / near expiry' photo+replace; quality 'Quality not as expected' replace; size_fit 'Size / fit issue' replace; not_needed 'No longer needed' (no replace); other 'Other' commentRequired (no replace). CANCEL_REASON_CODES/CANCEL_REASONS: ordered_by_mistake 'Ordered by mistake', better_price 'Found a better price elsewhere', delivery_too_long 'Delivery is taking too long', change_address 'Want to change address / phone', change_items 'Want to change items or quantity', payment_issue 'Payment issue', other 'Other' (commentRequired). MAX_RETURN_IMAGES = 6; REASON_MAX_CHARS = 300; OTHER_REASON_MIN_CHARS = 10; findReturnReason(codeOrText) (exact code match, else case-insensitive label match of the text before the first ':'); returnReasonRequiresPhotos({reasonCode?, reason}) = true if EITHER the code's or the text-prefix's reason has photoRequired (stricter wins); composeReason(label, comments, max=300) = comments.trim() ? `${label}: ${comments.trim()}` : label, truncated to max chars.

4. packages/shared/src/order-tracking.test.ts + packages/shared/src/returns.test.ts: labels (out_for_delivery -> 'Out for delivery', unknown 'in_transit_hub' humanized), furthestStatus (delivered+out_for_delivery -> delivered; packed+out_for_delivery -> out_for_delivery; cancelled always wins), reconcileTracking (order delivered, shipment status 'packed', events packed/shipped/out_for_delivery -> latestStatus 'delivered', shipment.status 'delivered', providerStatus 'packed', events[0] derived 'delivered'; duplicate events collapsed; cancelled order -> no derived events; order with no shipments -> latest = order status; returned -> derives up to delivered), returns helpers (photo rule by code and by text prefix, stricter-wins, composeReason truncation at 300). Run `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test` then `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build`.

5. apps/api/src/integrations/shipping/shipping.provider.ts: add `export interface TrackingContext { orderStatus?: string; since?: string }` and change the port to `getTracking(awb: string, ctx?: TrackingContext)` (ShiprocketProvider keeps its 1-arg signature - valid TS). Rewrite MockShippingProvider.getTracking(_awb, ctx): steps packed('Shipment packed', Warehouse) -> shipped('Handed to courier', Bengaluru) -> out_for_delivery('Out for delivery', Destination hub) -> delivered('Delivered to customer', Destination); reach = progressRank(ctx.orderStatus) (returned -> delivered; cancelled/pending/confirmed/unknown/no ctx -> packed only); event i at (Date.parse(ctx.since) || now) + i*30min, clamped to <= now. Update the class doc comment. Add apps/api/src/integrations/shipping/mock-shipping.provider.spec.ts: no ctx -> [packed]; 'shipped' -> [packed, shipped]; 'delivered' -> 4 events ending delivered; 'cancelled' -> [packed]; times ascending and never in the future.

6. apps/api/src/modules/orders/fulfilment.service.ts syncTracking: load the shipment AND its order first; call this.shipping.getTracking(awb, { orderStatus: order.status, since: shipment.createdAt.toISOString() }); load existing events (prisma.trackingEvent.findMany({where:{shipmentId}})) and only create updates whose key status|description|location is not already stored; compute target = furthest progress status among the updates (only shipped/out_for_delivery/delivered move the order, as before); update shipment.status when the furthest mapped status is one of the ShipmentStatus enum values packed/shipped/out_for_delivery/delivered and ranks above the current shipment status; advance the order by WALKING legal transitions (cur -> ORDER_PROGRESS_STEPS[rank+1] while canTransition(cur,next) and rank(next) <= rank(target)) and write a single prisma.order.update if it changed - state machine rules are untouched, only intermediate legal hops are taken (previously packed->out_for_delivery silently failed). Extend fulfilment.service.spec.ts with a `syncTracking` describe: passes ctx {orderStatus, since} to the provider; skips already-stored events; sets shipment status to the furthest; advances a packed order to out_for_delivery via shipped (one order.update with status out_for_delivery); does not move a cancelled order.

7. apps/api/src/modules/orders/order.service.ts getForCustomer: include `returns: { include: { items: true }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }` and `shipments: { include: { events: true } }`; after the ownership check load the address (`prisma.address.findUnique({ where: { id: order.addressId } })`, returned only when address.customerId === customerId, shaped {fullName, phone, line1, line2, city, state, pincode} else null); extend productMetaForVariants to also return `isReturnable` (product.isReturnable) and `attributes` (variant.attributesJson as Record<string,string>, {} if not an object) - items get `isReturnable: meta?.isReturnable ?? true` (mirrors ReturnService which skips missing variants) and `attributes`; compute `tracking = reconcileTracking({ order, shipments: order.shipments })`; return {...order, address, items, returns: order.returns.map(r => ({id, status, reason, resolution, images: (Array.isArray(r.imagesJson) ? r.imagesJson.filter(string) : []), items: r.items.map({orderItemId, quantity}), createdAt, updatedAt})), shipments: order.shipments.map(s => ({...s, status: reconciled status for s.id})), tracking}. Keep reorder/invoice/tracking ownership calls working. In orders.controller.ts make GET /orders/:id/tracking return `(await this.orders.getForCustomer(user.sub, id)).tracking` (FulfilmentService.getTimeline stays for compatibility). Update order.service.spec.ts: add `address: { findUnique: async () => null }` to the removed-variants prisma stub (and `shipments: []`, `returns: []` on the order fixture) and add a test: order status 'delivered' with shipment {status:'packed', events packed/shipped/out_for_delivery} -> res.tracking.latestStatus === 'delivered', res.shipments[0].status === 'delivered', res.tracking.shipments[0].events[0] is derived 'delivered'; plus items expose isReturnable/attributes and address is null when it belongs to someone else.

8. Customer return-photo upload: create apps/api/src/modules/media/customer-image-upload.ts exporting CUSTOMER_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES (15 MB), CUSTOMER_IMAGE_ALLOWED regex, UploadedFileLike and `storeCustomerImage(storage, file, folder): Promise<{url,key}>` containing the exact validation + key logic now inline in review-media.controller.ts (same messages); refactor ReviewMediaController to call it with 'reviews' (behaviour identical). Add apps/api/src/modules/media/return-media.controller.ts: `@ApiTags('return-media') @ApiBearerAuth() @Controller('orders/returns/media')`, `@Post('upload') @UseInterceptors(FileInterceptor('file', { limits: { fileSize: CUSTOMER_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES } }))` -> storeCustomerImage(storage, file, RETURN_MEDIA_FOLDER). Register it in media.module.ts controllers. (Path has 4 segments so it cannot collide with OrdersController's `:id/cancel` / `:id/reorder`.)

9. Return validation: create apps/api/src/modules/orders/return-images.ts exporting RETURN_MEDIA_FOLDER = 'returns' and `isOwnReturnImageUrl(url: string, prefix: string): boolean` = url.startsWith(prefix) && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\.[a-z0-9]{1,8}$/.test(url.slice(prefix.length)) (rejects other hosts, other folders, traversal, query strings). return-media.controller.ts imports RETURN_MEDIA_FOLDER from it. In orders.controller.ts returnSchema: images -> z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(1000)).max(MAX_RETURN_IMAGES).optional() (NOT .url(): local storage URLs are relative when PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unset; the service validates origin), add reasonCode: z.enum(RETURN_REASON_CODES).optional(), add items: z.array(z.object({ orderItemId: z.string().uuid(), quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(1000) })).min(1).max(100).optional(). In return.service.ts: inject `@Inject(STORAGE_PROVIDER) private readonly storage: StorageProvider` as the 5th constructor param; accept reasonCode in the input type; after the delivered check: (a) when input.items is given reject duplicate orderItemIds, ids not in order.items ('Item does not belong to this order'), and quantity > ordered - already requested in this order's non-rejected returns (prisma.returnRequest.findMany({ where: { orderId, status: { not: 'rejected' } }, include: { items: true } })) with a clear 400 ('Only N of "<title>" can still be returned'); keep the existing default (all items) when omitted and run the same remaining-qty check on it; (b) keep the non-returnable check; (c) images = unique trimmed input.images ?? []; if returnReasonRequiresPhotos({reasonCode, reason}) && images.length === 0 -> 400 `Please add at least one photo of the product - photos are required for "<label>" returns`; (d) prefix = this.storage.getUrl(`${RETURN_MEDIA_FOLDER}/`); any image failing isOwnReturnImageUrl -> 400 'Invalid photo - please upload photos using the return form'; then create as before with imagesJson: images.

10. Specs: extend apps/api/src/modules/orders/return.service.spec.ts (update both existing `new ReturnService(...)` calls with a 5th storage stub `{ getUrl: (k: string) => `https://cdn.belzo.test/${k}` }`): rejects reason 'Damaged / broken product: cracked' (and reasonCode 'damaged') with no images (BadRequest, message mentions photo); accepts it with 1 own URL `https://cdn.belzo.test/returns/<uuid>.jpg` and the create payload has that imagesJson + items; rejects a foreign URL 'https://evil.example/returns/<uuid>.jpg' and a reviews/ folder URL; accepts 'No longer needed' with zero photos; rejects an orderItemId not in the order; rejects quantity above remaining after an existing non-rejected return. Add apps/api/src/modules/media/return-media.controller.spec.ts: rejects missing file / non-image mimetype; stores under `returns/<uuid>.<ext>` and the returned url satisfies isOwnReturnImageUrl(url, storage.getUrl('returns/')). Run the FEAT verification.

11. Commit on master (stage only the touched files): `feat(shared): order status labels, tracking reconciliation and return/cancel reasons` for packages/shared, and `fix(orders): live tracking status, return photo upload and validated return requests` for apps/api.
acceptance_criteria: GET /orders/:id for an order with status delivered whose shipment is 'packed' with events up to out_for_delivery returns tracking.latestStatus 'delivered', shipments[i].status 'delivered' and a derived 'delivered' event first in tracking.shipments[i].events (covered by order.service.spec.ts).

GET /orders/:id additionally returns address (or null), items[].isReturnable, items[].attributes, returns[] (status, resolution, reason, images, items) and tracking; ownership check unchanged (ForbiddenException for another customer).
MockShippingProvider.getTracking returns events only up to the order status passed in ctx (mock-shipping.provider.spec.ts).
syncTracking no longer duplicates events, updates shipment.status and advances the order only through legal transitions (fulfilment.service.spec.ts).

POST /orders/returns returns 400 for photo-required reasons with no photos, 400 for image URLs not under storage.getUrl('returns/'), 400 for foreign/over-quantity items, and succeeds with >=1 own photo (return.service.spec.ts).

POST /orders/returns/media/upload exists for customers with the same type/size limits as review uploads and stores under returns/ (return-media.controller.spec.ts); review uploads behave exactly as before.
No change to prisma/schema.prisma, ORDER_TRANSITIONS, canCustomerCancel, pricing, invoice code.
pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test, pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck, lint and test all pass.
verification: pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck (must still pass - web does not consume the new fields yet)
findings:
COMMITS (master, not pushed): fa79073 feat(shared): order status labels, tracking reconciliation and return/cancel reasons; 4247d57 fix(orders): live tracking status, return photo upload and validated return requests. NOTE: several touched API files were previously UNTRACKED in git (shipping.provider.ts, mock-shipping.provider.ts, media.module.ts, review-media.controller.ts, orders.controller.ts, return.service.ts, return.service.spec.ts) and are now added in full by 4247d57; many other app files are still untracked (pre-existing repo state). FEAT-002 web files like apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/page.tsx, lib/catalogue-api.ts, lib/customer-upload.ts are also untracked - stage them by name when committing.

SHARED EXPORTS (from '@belzo/shared'): order-tracking.ts -> ORDER_PROGRESS_STEPS (readonly OrderStatus[] pending..delivered), ORDER_STATUS_LABELS (Record<OrderStatus,string>), TRACKING_STATUS_LABELS (created/picked_up/in_transit/rto/refunded), TRACKING_PROGRESS_MAP, normalizeStatus(s), statusLabel(s), progressRank(s), isTerminalOrderStatus(s), furthestStatus(orderStatus, trackingStatuses[]): OrderStatus, reconcileTracking(input): ReconciledTracking; types DateLike, ReconcileEventInput, ReconcileShipmentInput, ReconcileInput, TimelineEvent, ReconciledShipment, ReconciledTracking. TimelineEvent.status is the NORMALIZED status. returns.ts -> RETURN_REASON_CODES, type ReturnReasonCode, interface ReturnReason {code,label,photoRequired,allowReplace,commentRequired}, RETURN_REASONS, CANCEL_REASON_CODES, type CancelReasonCode, interface CancelReason {code,label,commentRequired}, CANCEL_REASONS, MAX_RETURN_IMAGES=6, REASON_MAX_CHARS=300, OTHER_REASON_MIN_CHARS=10, findReturnReason(codeOrText), returnReasonRequiresPhotos({reasonCode?, reason?}), composeReason(label, comments?, max=300).

GET /orders/:id RESPONSE (all Prisma Order scalars as before: id, customerId, addressId, status, subtotal, discount, shipping, codFee, tax, cgst, sgst, igst, grandTotal, couponCode, invoiceUrl, cancelledReason, createdAt, updatedAt (ISO strings over JSON), payments[], invoice|null) PLUS/CHANGED: address: {fullName:string; phone:string; line1:string; line2:string|null; city:string; state:string; pincode:string} | null (null when missing or not owned). items[]: OrderItem scalars {id, orderId, variantId, title, sku, unitPrice, quantity, taxRatePct} + imageUrl:string|null, slug:string|null, isReturnable:boolean (true when the variant was deleted), attributes: Record<string,string> (variant.attributesJson primitive values stringified; {} if none - read with pickAttr(attrs,'size') / pickAttr(attrs,'colour','color')). returns[] (newest first): {id:string; status:'requested'|'approved'|'picked'|'received'|'refunded'|'rejected'; reason:string; resolution:'refund_source'|'refund_wallet'|'replace'; images:string[]; items:{orderItemId:string; quantity:number}[]; createdAt; updatedAt}. shipments[]: raw Prisma Shipment {id, orderId, provider, awb, courier, status, trackingUrl, labelUrl, manifestUrl, estimatedDelivery, createdAt, updatedAt, events[] (raw, unsorted, may contain duplicates)} with status OVERWRITTEN by the reconciled value. tracking: ReconciledTracking = {orderStatus:OrderStatus; latestStatus:OrderStatus; latestLabel:string; shipments: {id; awb:string|null; courier:string|null; trackingUrl:string|null; estimatedDelivery:string|null (ISO); providerStatus:string (raw DB); status:string (reconciled; equals order status for cancelled/returned); statusLabel:string; events: {status; label; description; location:string|null; occurredAt:string|null (ISO); derived:boolean}[] NEWEST FIRST, deduped, derived steps on top}[]}. Use tracking.shipments[].events for the UI, not shipments[].events. GET /orders/:id/tracking now returns exactly the `tracking` object above (ownership checked).

UPLOAD: POST /orders/returns/media/upload (multipart, field 'file', image/jpeg|png|webp|gif|avif, max 15 MB, customer JWT) -> {url, key} with key 'returns/<uuid>.<ext>'. Same error messages as review upload.

POST /orders/returns body: {orderId uuid; reason string 1..300 (send composeReason(label, comments)); reasonCode?: ReturnReasonCode; images?: string[] (max 6, the upload `url`s verbatim); resolution?: 'refund_source'|'refund_wallet'|'replace'; items?: {orderItemId uuid; quantity int 1..1000}[] (1..100)}. 400 messages: 'Each item can be listed only once', 'Item does not belong to this order', 'Only N of "<title>" can still be returned', '"<title>" is non-returnable and cannot be returned', 'Please add at least one photo of the product - photos are required for "<label>" returns', 'Invalid photo - please upload photos using the return form', 'Only delivered orders can be returned'. Remaining qty = ordered - sum of quantities in this order's non-rejected returns (web can compute the same from order.returns).

OTHER BEHAVIOUR: syncTracking dedupes by status|description|location, moves shipment.status forward only, walks legal transitions to the furthest of shipped/out_for_delivery/delivered in one order.update, and never moves pending (would bypass payment confirmation) or terminal orders. OrdersController no longer injects FulfilmentService (getTimeline kept on the service). No schema/ORDER_TRANSITIONS/canCustomerCancel/pricing/invoice changes.

VERIFICATION (all exit 0): pnpm --filter @belzo/shared test (11 suites, 212 tests); pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build; pnpm --filter @belzo/api typecheck; pnpm --filter @belzo/api lint; pnpm --filter @belzo/api test (29 suites, 293 tests); pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck.
